meaning.narrative: the scene the retelling is narrating at this unit
meaning.referent: the scene containing the specifically mentioned content
meaning.stated: the answer as the reply gave it, in the form a scorer reads
meaning.judgement: the answer decided against the source: scene, film (a film with no particular scene), time-outside (a time outside the film's clip: the film, no scene), none, invalid-scene (a real scene that is not a target), unknown-scene, unknown-film, invalid, omitted, unparsable-chunk
meaning.time: a condition that answers with a time keeps the raw film and time beside the scene that contains it; source.clock holds the scene intervals in exact fractions
meaning.extras: self-reported fields kept verbatim; not scores, not calibrated

inference_policy_id.reason: no inference executed; recorded model choice

context_policy_id.reason: the model read the film record and the session's recall

candidate_policy_id.reason: every target was offered in the prompt; no candidate set computed

failure.detail: unit omitted from the accepted reply
